title: More Activation
text: “Right. There’s definitely some traction here, I think. We need to figure out somehow what caused us to end up in these forms, and get back to our original ones.”
The moment we arrived at Cal Mira Island’s harbor, something like static electricity crackled through the ground, and the island’s outline seemed to flare red—so that must be a clue.
“I wanna go back to being human already. Yeah.”
“Naofumi-san, you still have room to crack jokes, huh.”
“Maintaining one’s own pace is important, indeed.”
“Know your limits!”
“I’m worried we’ll get scolded for causing another incident here too, but I already got word through the Queen to the kingdom beforehand. They’ll just have to make preparations.”
“Ah… I want to go back to normal from this form as soon as possible. Who could possibly fight looking like this…”
Ren was gazing off into the distance a little.
“From what I hear from Gaelion-san, Ren-san in other loops seems to manage just fine though. A dragon’s confirmed, and there’s suspicion of a bear too.”
“Thinking about it that way, Ren’s actually got quite the fated connection to changing forms across loops and events, huh.”
“Shut up. It’s still better than Motoyasu’s cross-dressing or his motorcycle.”
“What’s that supposed to mean? What’s wrong with me, exactly?”
Ren was picking a fight with me, I say.
“We ended up riding Motoyasu-san’s Drive Mode out of necessity, come to think of it.”
“Oh, you rode it?”
“Yes, but it’s strange—somehow riding it in this rabbit-uni form didn’t feel that out of place.”
“It’s probably because a person turning into a motorcycle is the weird part, right? In rabbit-uni form the fancy aspect gets emphasized more.”
“Father! Would you ride me now, perhaps?”
It seemed the topic had turned toward whether Father might actually ride my Drive Mode in this current form of mine.
“I don’t need to force myself to ride you or anything, it’s fine. Sakura-chan and Gaelion-chan are here after all.”
Ugh… Sakura-chan riding is fine, but it galled me that it was somehow taken for granted that Rival should ride on my back instead.
“In our current state, honestly, anyone can ride either of us—shoulder rides, piggyback, whatever.”
“Well, yeah… Before we left, all the kids in the village were riding on our backs and playing with us.”
Older Sister and Panda sat that one out since their protective instincts might have gone berserk, but the villagers and the Filolial-samas took turns giving us rides and playing around.
“Being a pet is tough work, huh… and Raph-chan’s been doing this the whole time.”
“Being doted on is hard work too, huh.”
“…Yeah.”
Ren was trembling while riding on Kurotaro’s back.
Chatting about such things, we arrived at the hotel on Cal Mira Island. A count serving as our guide came out to greet us.
“…Even though you are Heroes, to think I would lay eyes upon the very forms of the reclamation creatures we were told had vanished…”
The count observed us, seeming to choose his words carefully as he spoke.
“I’m aware of the story. I understand the item kept by the Four Heroes Church was the trigger for this incident, or so I’ve heard…”
“Our companions and the people at the Four Heroes Church have been analyzing it, and it seems it was likely something that had been somewhere in one of the reclamation sites around the world.”

We’d already informed the people connected to the Four Heroes Church before departing. When they traced the origin of the catalyst, apparently the records were old, but it had been donated to some section related to inscriptions kept within the church, or something like that. They traced it back further still. They managed to determine it was an item brought back by a Four Heroes party from the past.
“It is currently under investigation, however…”
Just then, staff members came trooping in from the direction we’d arrived from and began reporting something to the count.
“Ahem… Word has come in that activation has been observed on various islands starting right after the Heroes’ arrival.”
“Whoa… that’s an awfully blatant incident happening.”
The Prad Desert had already been dealt with, and the re-activation related to experience points in various regions had been carried out—but was it saying things were becoming even more active now?
“I heard leveling up in this world’s gotten pretty easy already, but with activation happening, what’s going to happen, I wonder?”
“Apparently the rate of leveling differs depending on whether you’re a Hero’s companion or not. Can’t we still expect more influx?”
“Even so, though…”
“It’s literally starting to feel like an EXP farming event…”
Just then, Rafuemon suddenly snapped back to herself and clapped her hands.
“Ah… Rafuemon just figured out how this connects to history later on. That’s why Filoko and Rafumi haven’t been getting involved.”
“What is it, Rafuemon-san? Seems like you understand something.”
Itsuki asked, furrowing his brow at Rafuemon.
“Umm… well… if Rafuemon tells you the answer, there’s a high chance it’ll cause all sorts of problems in the future, so Rafuemon wants Itsuki-kun and everyone to act the way you think is right.”
“I’d very much like to change things, but if we just throw in the towel here, we’re probably going to spend the rest of our lives as reclamation creatures, aren’t we?”
“Don’t say that even as a joke!”
“Indeed!”
“In Motoyasu-kun’s case, isn’t it more like he goes back to normal in the next loop?”
“There’s also the possibility it continues. That would be funny if it happened, wouldn’t it.”
I found Itsuki’s remark unacceptable, but let’s try imagining it anyway. Say, for instance, the situation right after the summoning.
While Ren, Itsuki, and Father were all looking around, unable to grasp the situation, there I was—in rabbit-uni form.
“A… a rabbit?”
“My name is Motoyasu Kitamura, indeed!”
“Ah, right… a talking rabbit—now that feels like coming to another world!”

I could picture Father getting all excited like that. But the castle folk would recognize me as a Demi-Human, and on top of that as the Spear Hero, so they’d surely take notice… that in itself wouldn’t be a problem, but why is it—I could picture myself being petted by Father.

I could picture Father persistently talking to me, out of some sense that this confirmed we’d really come to another world. This wasn’t a bad situation at all, honestly. And then, one morning, the magic’s effect would wear off, and I’d reveal my true form before Father.
“Uh, um… Motoyasu-kun? Is that you, nano?”
“That’s right, indeed!”
For some reason the scene that played out showed him putting distance between us, but surely that’s a mistake!
“Motoyasu-san seems to be lost in thought about something.”
“Hmm… I have a feeling he’s thinking something weird. I hope he doesn’t say something strange again.”
“Father! If you woke up one morning and the rabbit you thought I was turned out to be human, how do you think you’d react, I wonder?”
“What is this, some one-shot gag manga aimed at women?… I can picture myself getting dragged around by a naked Motoyasu-kun, and honestly, please don’t.”
“Hey. You two are getting off track. Should we get Rafuemon to spill more details instead?”
“R-Rafuemon can only answer that Itsuki-kun and the other Heroes’ efforts make the world a better place, that’s all.”

“Hmm… I guess we’re caught up in some feature-film-length event, but Itsuki in Riska form—how would that even work? Feels like something straight out of a children’s picture book aimed purely at kids.”
“What kind of bit is that! Please stop turning everything into a joke!”
Father sure knew a lot of specifics, huh.
“Anyway, it seems our arrival on the island is what triggered the activation, but Itsuki, does anything come to mind?”
“Right. Count, is there anything in the island’s legends or similar events that might tell us how to undo this state we’re in?”
“Y-yes! Please give me a moment.”
The count took Itsuki’s words to heart and began thoroughly investigating the island’s legends and the like. However, it seemed no records were found addressing how to fix our current situation.
“Maybe coming to Cal Mira Island first was a mistake.”
“Why’s that?”
“This is an island near Melromarc, which used to be all about human supremacy. If there were any records saying a Hero turned into a reclamation creature, they’d have erased it without a doubt.”
Both Itsuki and I found ourselves convinced by Ren’s words.
“That’s certainly true… Maybe investigating a different reclamation site is the way to go.”
“Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan apparently don’t remember anything about this incident either… so I guess we just have to search thoroughly.”
“Nano-oon!”
Rival came flying in just then.
“Found a disturbance in the magic power, nano. Maybe there’s something to it, nano.”
